title: Norsine's bioenergetics work with Duncan Luri

tellings.quote: John was working with him on [sighs and gasps]

plain: A man named John Norsine is said to have worked with a man named Duncan Laurie in Jamestown, Rhode Island, on bioenergetics, the study of energy in living things. A witness named Jim Weiner mentions it second-hand, from what he was told, and in the moment he only gets as far as saying John was working with him on it, so what they actually did goes unsaid.
